capabilities: Render notes as stars in a 3D force-layout graph
Animate an accretion disk, bloom, orbital motion and quasar jets
Show a dashboard with greeting, clock, stats, folder constellations and recent notes
Open notes by clicking stars and highlight their links on hover
Center the galaxy on a note or tag and adapt rendering quality
disambiguation: Not an astronomy or stargazing notebook; it is a 3D graph view of the vault's notes and links.
extras: Runs on WebGL; glow and resolution step down when frames drop and a lost context rebuilds itself. Installable manually or through BRAT. Built with three.js (MIT).
problem: Obsidian's graph is flat and static, so there is no spatial, animated way to see how notes, projects and links relate.
summary: 3D note graph that turns notes into stars orbiting an animated black hole, plus a dashboard with clock, stats and recent notes.
